scenario.topic: Which cloud gaming service should the LAN party group adopt

options.name: NVIDIA GeForce NOW
options.upside: Supports a wide range of devices and allows playing games you already own.
options.concern: Session length limits apply on free tier and some latency may occur on lower-end connections.

options.name: Xbox Cloud Gaming (xCloud)
options.upside: Includes access to Xbox Game Pass library with multiplayer support.
options.concern: Requires Xbox Game Pass Ultimate subscription and has limited browser support.

options.name: Google Stadia
options.upside: Offers 4K streaming on Pro tier and integrates with YouTube for easy sharing.
options.concern: Game purchases are required in addition to subscription and service availability is limited in some regions.

options.name: Amazon Luna

attrs.device_compatibility: PC, Mac, Fire TV, iOS, Android

options.upside: Lower monthly cost with channels offering different game selections.
options.concern: Smaller library and requires stable internet for smooth multiplayer experience.

shared_context: The LAN party group of 5 is selecting a cloud gaming service to use during their events. Each service supports multiplayer gaming, has varying subscription costs, game library sizes, and device compatibility.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a tech-savvy gamer who enjoys exploring multiplayer games on various devices.
personas.private_goal: Find a service with a large game library and broad device compatibility for group play.

A.reason_for: Supports many devices and lets us play games we already own.
A.reason_against: Session limits on free tier and possible latency issues could disrupt gameplay.

B.reason_for: Includes Xbox Game Pass with multiplayer games and good device support.

C.reason_for: Offers 4K streaming and YouTube integration for sharing highlights.
C.reason_against: Smaller library and extra game purchases needed beyond subscription.

D.reason_against: Smaller library and concerns about stable internet for multiplayer.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam prefers budget-friendly options and values straightforward solutions.
personas.private_goal: Choose the most affordable service that still supports multiplayer well.

A.reason_for: Good device compatibility and large library.
A.reason_against: Subscription cost is higher than some alternatives.

B.reason_for: Good multiplayer support and game pass access.
B.reason_against: More expensive and requires specific subscription.

C.reason_against: Requires game purchases and smaller library make it less cost-effective.

D.reason_for: Lowest monthly cost and decent device support.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a casual gamer who prefers simplicity and playing games she already owns.
personas.private_goal: Use a service that lets me play my existing games with minimal hassle.

A.reason_for: Allows playing games I already own on many devices.

B.reason_for: Good multiplayer and game pass access.
B.reason_against: Subscription requirements and browser limits complicate use.

C.reason_against: Need to buy games separately and smaller library reduce appeal.

D.reason_against: Smaller library and internet stability concerns.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a competitive gamer focused on cost efficiency and reliable multiplayer experiences.
personas.private_goal: Select a low-cost service that supports smooth multiplayer gaming for the group.

A.reason_for: Large library and device support are positives.
A.reason_against: Potential latency and session limits could hurt competitive play.

B.reason_for: Good multiplayer and game pass library.
B.reason_against: Higher cost and subscription complexity are downsides.

C.reason_for: 4K streaming is nice but not essential.
C.reason_against: Smaller library and extra purchases make it less appealing.

D.reason_for: Lowest cost and acceptable device compatibility for our needs.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina enjoys casual gaming and values easy access to popular multiplayer titles.
personas.private_goal: Find a service with good multiplayer games and reasonable cost.

A.reason_for: Large library and device flexibility are good.
A.reason_against: Session limits and latency could be problematic.

B.reason_for: Includes Xbox Game Pass with many multiplayer games.

C.reason_for: 4K streaming and YouTube integration are nice extras.
C.reason_against: Smaller library and extra game purchases reduce value.

D.reason_against: Smaller library and internet stability concerns.
